description: Get a concise GEO readiness summary for a domain: overall score, grade, top 3 strengths, and top 3 issues to fix. Use this for a quick overview; use analyze_domain for full details including the Trust Signal Evidence payload (raw nav/footer links for LLM-driven semantic classification on non-English sites).

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. "example.com". Do not include https:// prefix.

render_mode.description: How to fetch the homepage. "static" (default), "auto" (static with Chrome fallback on bot-block), or "chrome" (always render via local headless Chrome).

name: get_geo_summary
